## Project summary

This project analyzes **July 2024 street-animal feeding activity** published by the **Ankara Provincial Health Directorate** (`Ankara İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü`). The spreadsheet records, by date and neighborhood, how many **feeding points** were active, the **average daily dry food** distributed (kg), and rolling **vehicle** and **personnel** counts used in feeding operations across Ankara districts.

**Objectives:** (1) describe spatial and temporal patterns; (2) compare districts in terms of feeding intensity; (3) highlight data-quality issues (e.g. coded missing values, typos) for transparent reporting.

## Key takeaways

- **Topic:** Municipal **street animal (“sokak hayvanı”) feeding** logistics in **Greater Ankara** during **July 2024**, using official health-directorate-style operational records.
- **Data:** **367** neighborhood-day rows with **district**, **street/mahalle**, **feeding-point counts**, **average dry food (kg/day)**, and **vehicle / personnel** staffing indicators.
- **Important aspects:** Food amounts were stored as text (e.g. `"84 KG"`); vehicle counts sometimes use `"-"` (missing) or a typo **`Y3`** instead of **`3`** — we document and clean these in the Data page.
- **Interesting results:** Districts differ strongly in how many rows (neighborhood-days) appear and in the **distribution of kg/day** per feeding point; some operational fields are almost constant across rows (see Analysis).
- **Main outcome:** A reproducible **Quarto** site plus a cleaned **`.RData`** object for graders, suitable for your **GitHub Pages** presentation and **HADI** PDF submission.
